title: Thunder Hammer Warrior
description: A female warrior with purple hair stands in a dynamic combat pose, powerfully swinging a large ornate hammer crackling with intense purple lightning. She wears a white and purple cropped top with matching pants, arm guards, and boots, surrounded by bright electrical energy effects against a solid dark gray background.
